summary: This is an 8-K filed by Cerebras Systems Inc. reporting the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) of 34.5 million shares of Class A common stock at $185.00 per share, generating gross proceeds of $6.4 billion, along with related charter and bylaw amendments. The filing is a routine current report of an IPO completion and corporate governance changes, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The events are standard post-IPO mechanics.
